data.title: [ASCM] Anomaly detected: ASCM Daily Data Check
data.description:
**Incident Description:**  
The ASCM application in the PROD environment is experiencing a failure in the ASCM Daily Data Check rule, detected on the business date 2026-05-06. The rule failed due to the absence of the expected TARGETDATE value "2026-05-06" in the METADATA table, with the observed value being "None." Logs indicate that the job run on 2026-04-26 loaded data for TARGETDATE "2026-04-26," skipping 3 records due to null TARGETDATE values, resulting in incomplete data (841 of 844 records loaded). This incomplete data is the root cause of the rule failure during validation. The business impact includes potential delays or inaccuracies in downstream processes reliant on the TARGETDATE validation.
